newsitem.title: FRANCE: Four die in floods in northern France.
newsitem.headline: Four die in floods in northern France.

text.p: Torrential rains and flooding hit the northern French city of Rouen overnight, killing four people, local officials said on Tuesday.
A woman and her two children aged three and seven were swept away by mud near their home in the Rouen suburb of Lavau-Paliere, officials said.
A motorist was killed in an accident in the city centre, blamed on poor visibility due to the heavy rainfall.
Roofs, trees and cars were damaged in the downpour and several dozen individuals were evacuated from their homes by helicopter during the night.
Hundreds of cars were immobilised for several hours on the nearby A-15 highway between Rouen and the town of Yvetot to the west, police said.
